description:
Change reverse DNS records for a Floating IP

Change the reverse DNS records for this [Floating IP](#tag/floating-ips).

Allows to modify the PTR records set for the IP address.

dns_ptr.description:
Domain Name to point to.

PTR record content used for reverse DNS. Set to null to reset (IPv4) to the default value or remove (IPv6) the record.

ip.description: Single IPv4 or IPv6 address to create pointer for.

wait.description: Poll the resulting action until success/error or timeout.

name: hcloud_floating_ip_change_dns_ptr_action
